## KEY POINT

The inclusion of drop sets in a resistance training program is of questionable benefit to hypertrophy when total session volume is equated. However, drop sets may be useful for increasing total training volume without substantially increasing session duration. This not only makes workouts more efficient, but it can also potentially reduce fatigue occurring from extended-duration training sessions. Given the need to train to failure when employing drop sets, it may be best to limit the strategy to the last set of a given exercise. Weight stack machines are particularly well-suited to drop set training because loads can be quickly decreased simply by moving a pin.
